question: Who was the first Indian to be elected to the Communist International leadership class?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manvendra Nath Roy**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manvendra Nath Roy:**

 
 
• M.N. Roy was a prominent Indian revolutionary, radical activist, and political theorist.
 
• He was a key figure in the communist movement in India and internationally.
 
• He was elected to the leadership of the Communist International (Comintern), demonstrating his significant role in the global communist movement.
 
• He was involved in communist activities in Mexico and the Soviet Union.
 
• He later developed his own philosophy of Radical Humanism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shripad Amrit Dange:**

 
 
• S.A. Dange was a founding member of the Communist Party of India (CPI).
 
• He was a prominent figure in the Indian trade union movement.
 
• He played a significant role in organizing labor movements in India.
 
• He was a very important leader of the communist movement within India.
 
• He spent many years in jail, for his political activities.
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru:**
 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was a key leader in the Indian independence movement and India's first Prime Minister.
 
• He was a socialist and had some leanings towards communist ideals.
 
• However, he was not a member of the Communist International leadership.
 
• He was a very important political figure in the 20th century.
 
• He was a very influential leader in the non-aligned movement.
 
 
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai:**
 
 
• Lala Lajpat Rai was a prominent Indian nationalist leader.
 
• He was a member of the "Lal Bal Pal" triumvirate and a key figure in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was not associated with the Communist International.
 
• He was a strong advocate for Indian self-rule.
 
• He died during a protest against the Simon Commission.
